text:
marco: Quick sync: roles matrix view in org settings  collapsed rows cause confusion. On mobile the chevron to expand a role is too small and not touch-friendly; also keyboard focus area is tiny. screenshot: https://img.redwood.local/ux/roles-matrix-mobile.png
lina: I noticed this too on my phone. The hit target is ~24px now. We should make it at least 44px per platform a11y guidelines.
kyle: Expansion state is also not clearly announced by screen readers. We use aria-expanded on the chevron button, but the row doesn't have an accessible name. Need aria-controls and IDs.
tess: Proposed changes: 1) increase chevron button padding to 44px touch target; 2) ensure chevron has aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing to the panel id; 3) add role="region" and aria-label on expanded panel like "Permissions for Developers".
marco: Also copy nudge: change chevron tooltip from "Expand" to "Show role details" for clarity. But keep short.
lina: Visual nits: when collapsed, row height is tight. Increase vertical padding so focus ring doesn't overlap content.
kyle: Implementation tradeoff: increasing padding affects density. Maybe use denser mode switch for power users.
tess: For keyboard users we should ensure the chevron is reachable via tab. Right now the row itself is focusable which steals focus. Change so the chevron, role name, and actions are individual tabbable elements.
accessibility-bot: Checklist: 1) touch target >=44px, 2) aria-expanded on chevron, 3) aria-controls + id pairing, 4) role="region" + label for panels, 5) ensure focus management on expand (focus moves into panel header), 6) test with NVDA and VoiceOver.
marco: Can we also add a small visual affordance for keyboard-only users: a visible expand/collapse label when focused? e.g., show "Show details" text inline when chevron receives focus.
lina: That could help. Ensure it doesn't appear for hover only (touch devices).
kyle: I'll draft the PR and include screenshots for dense vs normal modes. Will add unit tests for aria attributes.
tess: Copy suggestions: "Show role details" and "Hide role details". Use sentence case.
marco: Great. Let's get this in beta. We'll demo mobile tap target and NVDA announcements at design review. :rocket:
